bullets: Built and maintain a RAG-based customer support chatbot (FastAPI) deployed as an embedded widget on client websites for FAQ and product support.
Fixed retrieval failures on tabular and numeric queries by reworking chunking and chunk-linkage, preserving row-column relationships needed for exact figures.
Reduced response latency by implementing caching for embeddings and repeated query-response pairs based on historical usage patterns.
Containerized the service with Docker and managed cloud deployment; designed and exposed FastAPI endpoints to serve AI/RAG services to client applications.
Added client-facing controls (temperature tuning, knowledge base updates via admin panel) enabling clients to adjust chatbot behavior without engineering support.
Built and deployed AI-powered WhatsApp education platform end-to-end using Django, PostgreSQL, OpenAI API, and Celery via Twilio API.
Implemented stateful retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system with Celery Beat automated week-wise progression, decreasing teacher workload by 40%.
Architected multi-conversation AI engine with prompt orchestration supporting 5 interaction types, maintaining conversation history and state across concurrent user sessions.
Containerized application with Docker, established GitHub Actions CI/CD to GCP with Nginx reverse proxy; deployed Celery workers and Redis reducing API latency by 50%.
Built end-to-end NLP pipelines for resume classification and recommendation systems using machine learning, including TF-IDF vectorization and feature engineering.
Developed collaborative filtering and content-based recommendation models, deploying real-time ML inference systems using Streamlit with optimized latency.
